segments.text: Medicine-carrying drones expand across Rwanda. Also coming up: Smart glasses show live subtitles for deaf users. And later, our number of the day. This is TECH BYTES. I'm Max Circuit, with Ada Volt.
From Circuit Weekly: Drones now deliver medicine to 400 health centres across Rwanda, the operator says. The average flight takes about 30 minutes.
segments.headline: Medicine-carrying drones expand across Rwanda

segments.text: Thanks, Max. Circuit Weekly reports that a company in Berlin has shown smart glasses that display live subtitles of conversations. “We want everyone to follow the conversation,” a spokesperson said.
segments.headline: Smart glasses show live subtitles for deaf users

quote.text: We want everyone to follow the conversation

segments.text: Our number of the day: 3 percent. From Starfield Journal: Measurements show a large glacier in the Alps lost 3 percent of its volume this summer. Scientists say the ice is now thinner than at any time since records began.
segments.headline: Glacier in the Alps shrinks by 3 percent in one summer

segments.text: And finally: Rangers have released 50 young giant tortoises on an island in the Galápagos where the species vanished about 100 years ago, Starfield Journal reports. “It is a homecoming,” a park ranger said.
segments.headline: Giant tortoises return to a Galápagos island

segments.text: Somewhere, a researcher is very pleased with themselves. Rightly.
That's TECH BYTES. From Ada Volt and from me, thanks for watching. More news around the clock on GLOBIT 24.
